selection: All seven JIRA project families absent from the earlier fixed benchmark, excluding camel and lucene. Highest listed non-beta/non-preview release per family; hbase 0.95.2 retained as explicitly listed. Selection based on repository inventory, not predictive outcomes.
status: pre-download selection; exploratory extension after earlier results
design: Leave one project family out; remaining six sources, max 400 source rows per project per seed. Three source-group tuning folds; two candidates per arm with independent choice and shared-baseline sensitivity. RF/ExtraTrees teachers, RF/LR downstream, three seeds 101-103; 32 trees, teacher depth5; 3-fold OOF. Weighting/uniform/shuffled, selection/random, prediction/SHAP augmentation. No target-labelled fitting.
